content.comment_body: Hello, I used to run [product_name] [version_no], but started programming a different module that required a more recent version. After installing [product_name] [version_no], I was able to download my programs, but the software crashed immediately afterward. Any communication, such as starting or stopping the module, resulted in an immediate crash. I've attached the error log (renamed as .jpg for forum upload purposes; you can change it to .txt) in case someone can interpret it. It seems related to a Java segfault and bus error. During installation, I received a conditional success message and was told to review the install log, which is also attached. However, it mostly listed transferred files and noted Java component linking, which I found unclear. I tried updating the USB drivers, which appeared successful, but I'm unsure if the previous drivers were properly removed.
The install log is attached. It shows my initial installation from 2011 and the more recent [version_no] attempt at the end.

Hello, The issue is with the serial driver librxtxSerial.jnilib, which does not match your MacOS architecture and version. I've attached a version of librxtxSerial.jnilib compatible with Mac OS 10.6. 1. Locate this file in your installation folder (per your log, it should be at: /Users/[user_name]/Applications/[product_name]_[version_no]/bin/librxtxSerial.jnilib ) 2. Extract the attached file and replace the original. I hope this resolves the issue.
This worked perfectly! I didn't even have to restart the software after replacing the file. Thanks for your quick and helpful support.
You're welcome, it's great to hear that your issue has been resolved.
Hello, I'm experiencing the same issue, but I use Mac OS 10.9. Will the driver you recommended also work for this version? Regards, [user_name]
Hello, The previously attached driver should work for OS 10.9. If you encounter any issues, please share your error log here.
I confirm the solution works on OSX Mavericks 10.9.3. Uploading, downloading, and monitoring with [product_name] [article_no] functions properly. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced crashes with [product_name] [version_no] following communication with hardware modules on MacOS. The crashes were linked to an incompatible serial driver. Providing the correct driver resolved stability issues and restored proper upload, download, and monitoring functions, emphasizing a need for better platform-specific driver support in the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the software to perform reliably during communication tasks such as program transfer, without crashing. Effective compatibility with current MacOS versions and straightforward driver update procedures are considered standard.
